featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrible experience today. I had asked to make a smart card and paid full money. i was asked to come after 24 hours. i went to collect after 30 hours but it was not ready and the staff was extremely rude. They asked to come later. When i said it was not possible,  one staff asked to me take the money back. When I asked them to give the phone number of the owner, they denied it.
After I started arguing and a few people gathered, one lady came up from inside and said she will get it done in 15 minutes. And lo behold! they did it in 15 minutes. So what was the attitude earlier all about?
I will never use their services again.

featured_reviews.name: Tejas Vora
featured_reviews.review_text: Very horrible support staff. Beware of this guys because they charge you for everything. Ridiculous staff behavior. Asked for 6" * 8" photo prints for which I was told 20 Rs per photo. When the prints came out it came on A4 paper. Now they charge 5 Rs extra per photo to cut from A4 to 6" * 8". So each photo instead of costing 20 Rs now costs 25 Rs. By this logic if you ask them to print 500 visiting cards, they will charge 5 rs for cutting one visiting card??? Then I asked them to give me cutter so I can cut it myself, to which the guy ridicules saying it will take 20 minutes just to give a normal Cutter. Worst service experience ever. Avoid this place if possible.
